external_prereqs: Current unencumbered LPN or LPTN license in Arkansas.
Graduation from an accredited or Arkansas State Board of Nursing approved LPN/LPTN program.
Completion of the 48-hour general education and nursing prerequisite block (BIOL, CHEM, ENGL, FAH, MATH 1113, NUR 2303, PSY 2003, SOC 1003, SFHS, USHG, TECH 1001, 1-hour elective) with GPA > 2.75.
Work history documentation (>1,000 hours nursing employment as an LPN in the 12-24 months preceding admission) if applying >12 months after LPN graduation or pursuing the hybrid track.
plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2025-2026 Arkansas Tech University Catalog, 'LPN to BSN Nursing Program' curriculum (pp. 284-285), a genuine institution-published semester sequence. This is a TRUE COMPLETION PROGRAM: admission requires a current unencumbered Arkansas LPN/LPTN license and completion of a 48-hour general education and nursing prerequisite block (GPA > 2.75); the catalog publishes semester-by-semester sequencing only for the nursing curriculum (Semesters 1-4). Seeded here is the genuine 4-semester nursing sequence (55 hours). The remaining degree hours are awarded outside any published sequence: 48 hours of prerequisite/general-education requirements and 17 hours of articulated credit under the Arkansas Nursing Education Progression Model (NUR 3103, NUR 3204, NUR 3213, NUR 3404, NUR 3513), awarded at completion of the last semester — together totaling the degree's 120 hours (48 + 17 + 55 = 120), per catalog footnote 6. Articulated-credit courses are listed in notes only, not seeded as taken courses. Footnote 4: a grade of 'C' or better required (marked courses). Footnote 5: one credit hour equals 3 contact hours for the marked clinical courses. Offered in traditional (face-to-face) or hybrid format; application deadlines May 1 (fall) and November 1 (spring). The program is approved by the Arkansas State Board of Nursing and the Arkansas Department of Higher Education and accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN). Machine prereqs omitted (prereq: []) — the curriculum page prints no per-course prerequisites. tccns mirrors the local ATU course code; transfer_confidence core_only.
